description: Use this when the user asks how much VAT they owe or can reclaim for a period, their output or input VAT, or the figures for their next VAT return from their records. VAT figures for one VAT period of the business, as the VAT report page shows them: sales and output VAT, credit notes, input VAT, reverse charge, net VAT, counts, breakdowns, the filing deadline and whether the period is marked filed. It is a summary of the user's records in Fatura Go, not a filed VAT return. period is due (the return due next, the default), open (the period today is in) or a key from periods. Needs the VAT reports permission. Do not use it for the figures laid out by VAT 201 box (get_vat_return_boxes) or for general VAT rules (explain_vat_return_boxes, check_vat_on_supply).

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out when the connection shares exactly one business.

period.description: due (default), open, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD from periods.

name: get_vat_summary
title: VAT summary for a period
